title: Population characteristics — Baseline characteristics
description: UK Biobank fields in the category Population characteristics > Baseline characteristics, as selected by the CD3 researchers.

f31.title: Sex
f31.$comment: Source coding (encoding 9): 0 Female; 1 Male. Acquired from central registry at recruitment, sometimes updated by the participant; may mix NHS-recorded and self-reported sex.

f33.title: Date of birth
f33.$comment: Marked private in UK Biobank's field list. Date format YYYY-MM-DD (ISO 8601) is assumed, not stated by the source (D015).

f34.title: Year of birth
f34.$comment: No plausibility bound stated by the source (D013).

f21022.title: Age at recruitment
f21022.x-derivation: Based on date of birth and date of attending the initial assessment centre; age on the day of that visit, truncated to whole years.

f22189.title: Townsend deprivation index at recruitment
f22189.$comment: Same source title and description as f189; this version's values are rounded to 2 decimal places, replacing an earlier unrounded version (f189, no longer available from UK Biobank) per the source's own notes. No plausibility bound stated (D013).
